noteSource: picker roll: YourMT3 rows with pack velocity (else loudness-derived)

sets.name: Opening: the first three melody notes
sets.why: The theme begins with three long notes, G-Ab-G, one per bar: the lone voice before the line moves.
sets.rule: G5 5.06, Ab5 7.58, G5 9.55 (the top of each cluster, by hand)

sets.name: Opening: the rising line to G5
sets.why: D5-Eb5-F5-Eb5-D5-Eb5-F5-G5: eight notes climbing a fourth, peak G5 at 13.18 s. Short and stepwise, so Ivory keeps its keys huddled.
sets.rule: roll notes 10.7-13.3 s at midi >= 74 (D5 and up)

sets.name: Opening: bass octaves
sets.why: The left hand strikes a low octave on each beat (C2/C3, C2/C3, B1/B2, C2/C3, Ab1/Ab2): the heavy half of the pulse.
sets.rule: roll notes 3.5-14.2 s at midi <= 48, clustered by 80 ms, lowest and highest of each

sets.name: Opening: off-beat chords
sets.why: The answering chord after each bass octave (G3-Eb4-G4, Ab3-Eb4-Ab4, G3-D4-F4-G4, G3-C4-Eb4-G4, C4-Eb4-Ab4): the light half of the pulse.
sets.rule: roll notes 5-14.2 s at midi 49-71, minus the melody sets, whole clusters (80 ms)

sets.name: Return: the turn
sets.why: The ornament the return adds: Eb5-F5-Eb5-F5-Eb5-D5-Eb5-F5-G5 in 1.5 s, the fastest notes of the opening. Four pitches flicking.
sets.rule: roll notes 30.7-32.4 s at midi >= 74

sets.name: Return: the melody (long notes)
sets.why: G5 Ab5 G5 F5, then after the turn D5 (32.62): the theme's long notes, one slab each.
sets.rule: G5 24.72, Ab5 26.90, G5 28.73, F5 29.91, D5 32.62 (by hand: the skyline would take the chord tops under the held notes)

sets.name: Return: bass octaves
sets.why: Eb1/Eb2, Ab1/Ab2, Bb1/Bb2, B1/B2-C2/C3, D2/D3: the bass climbs by steps under the return.
sets.rule: roll notes 23.5-33.6 s at midi <= 50, clustered by 80 ms, lowest and highest of each

sets.name: Return: off-beat chords
sets.why: The off-beat chords (G3-Bb3-Eb4-G4, F3-C4-Eb4, Bb3-D4-Ab4, A3-Eb4-G4, D4): the inner pulse.
sets.rule: roll notes 24.5-33.6 s at midi 51-69, minus the melody and the turn

sets.name: Climax: the rise to C6
sets.why: The line climbs B4-C5-D5-Eb5 and leaps to C6 (v93), the highest note of the first section: five keys, the stomp on C6.

sets.name: Climax: the chromatic fall from B5
sets.why: Straight after the peak the melody slides down B5-Bb5-A5-Ab5 and drops through F5 to Ab4 (v94 at the top): the same keys falling.

sets.name: Climax: the melody after the fall
sets.why: C#5, then C5-Eb5-C#5-C5 turning and climbing E5-Ab5-G5, C5-F5: the line picking itself up for the next wave.
sets.rule: roll notes 107.5-110.9 s at midi >= 72, minus the fall

sets.name: Climax: bass
sets.why: Eb3, Eb2, Eb2, F1, C#3, G1, E3, Ab1: one stroke per beat under the climax.
sets.rule: roll clusters (80 ms) 101.2-110.6 s whose lowest note is at midi <= 52: that lowest note

sets.name: Climax: the beat chords
sets.why: What the left hand and thumbs add on each beat (Ab3-C4, Bb2-G4, Eb3-C4, F2, Ab3-C#4, E4, G2, Bb3-C4, Ab2-F4): the chord under every melody step.
sets.rule: roll notes 101.9-110.6 s below midi 80 (after the C5-D5 turn), minus the melody sets and the bass

sets.name: Chorale: cadence and roots
sets.why: The deep C that ends the first section, a silence, then the chorale's roots C2, G1, G2: few, slow, low.
sets.rule: C1/C2 at 117.60 (the C minor cadence), then the lowest note of each roll cluster 123-127.5 s at midi <= 45

sets.name: Chorale: the lone voice
sets.why: After the cadence a single quiet voice wanders down (Bb3-A3-F#3-Ab3-F3) and becomes the chorale's soprano (E4-D4-E4): the ball of light before the hymn.
sets.rule: the link notes Bb3 118.94, A3 120.15, F#3 120.21, Ab3 121.63, F3 121.68, then the chorale's top note E4 123.65, D4 126.02, E4 127.16 (by hand)

sets.name: Chorale: the first chords
sets.why: Poco più lento: the hymn's chords, C major (C3-E3-G3-C4), G7 (F3-B3), (F3-B3): soft (v40-50), held, spaced.
sets.rule: roll notes 123.6-127.5 s at midi 46-63, the soprano excluded

sets.name: Storm: bass octaves climbing, then trembling
sets.why: The left hand climbs in octaves A2-Bb2-B2-C3-C#3-D3, then shakes G2/G3-A2/A3 back and forth (220-221.5), then G1/G2 fff at 221.95.
sets.rule: roll notes 217.2-222 s at midi <= 61, clustered by 40 ms, lowest and highest of each

sets.name: Storm: the hammered chords
sets.why: The right hand's G4-F5-G5 chords over the climbing bass, the v99 C-E chord at 219.00, then the fff chords G-E-G-E (221.95) to C6 (224.84): the blows.
sets.rule: roll clusters 217.2-225 s at midi >= 64 with >= 3 notes; of each, lowest and highest

sets.name: Storm: left-hand arpeggios
sets.why: Between the fff chords the left hand runs up G3-D4-F4, G3-E4, G3-D4-G4, C3-G3-C4: an inner voice that springs up into each blow.
sets.rule: roll notes 222.5-225 s at midi <= 67, minus the chord set

sets.name: Storm: the octave melody falling from C7
sets.why: The melody in four octaves from C7: C-D-C-G-A-G-E-F-E-C-D-C, falling a step at a time through the top of the keyboard.
sets.rule: top note of each roll cluster 225.4-227.55 s
